an5.88:1.1: pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu bahujanāhitāya paṭipanno hoti bahujanāsukhāya bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ
an5.88:2.5: bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo …pe… diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā
an5.88:2.6: micchādiṭṭhiko hoti viparītadassano so bahujanaṃ saddhammā vuṭṭhāpetvā asaddhamme patiṭṭhāpeti
an5.88:2.7: thero bhikkhu rattaññū cirapabbajito itipissa diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjanti ñāto thero bhikkhu yasassī sagahaṭṭhapabbajitānaṃ bahujanaparivāro itipissa diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjanti lābhī thero bhikkhu cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ itipissa diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjanti bahussuto thero bhikkhu sutadharo sutasannicayo itipissa diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjanti
an5.88:2.8: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu bahujanāhitāya paṭipanno hoti bahujanāsukhāya bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.
an5.88:3.1: pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu bahujanahitāya paṭipanno hoti bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ
an5.88:4.5: bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo …pe… diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā
an5.88:4.6: sammādiṭṭhiko hoti aviparītadassano so bahujanaṃ asaddhammā vuṭṭhāpetvā saddhamme patiṭṭhāpeti
an5.88:4.7: thero bhikkhu rattaññū cirapabbajito itipissa diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjanti ñāto thero bhikkhu yasassī sagahaṭṭhapabbajitānaṃ bahujanaparivāro itipissa diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjanti lābhī thero bhikkhu cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ itipissa diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjanti bahussuto thero bhikkhu sutadharo sutasannicayo itipissa diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjanti
an5.88:4.8: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu bahujanahitāya paṭipanno hoti bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānanti.
